name: Erin

origin.summary: Honors Canadian Army Master Corporal Erin Doyle, 32, killed in a firefight in the Panjwaii District of Afghanistan on August 11, 2008. Dumbbell split cleans and pull-ups — one of the few Heroes built on a dumbbell staple.

description: Five rounds of dumbbell split cleans and pull-ups — a two-movement couplet pairing a single-dumbbell Olympic-lift variant with high-rep pull-ups.
source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/erin (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09
